answer: Gate new identities through a rotating jury. First, an applicant posts a deposit and an activity sample. Second, seven established peers are picked at random to review it blind, and admission needs five of seven threshold signatures. Third, the jury reshuffles every epoch, so bribes cannot be arranged in advance, shifting like a dune in wind. Faking 10,000 identities needs about 50,000 corrupt juror votes at $50 each, $2.5 million, plus every rejected deposit burned. Honest agents rest like ships in a harbor, while fakes crack under review like a glacier calving ice.
